description: This file defines an in-memory singleton repository for managing Profile objects within an Android application. It provides mechanisms to store, retrieve, and add new profiles, which include connection details such as host, port, username, and password. The repository uses Kotlin coroutines' StateFlow for observable data streams.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: A singleton object that manages a list of Profile instances in-memory, providing methods to add profiles and observe profile list updates.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Referenced as a data class representing individual profile data, including connection details such as id, name, host, port, username, and password.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Creates and adds a new Profile to the repository, returning the created Profile object. It handles optional ID assignment and updates the observable list of profiles.
